architectural.heading: Thank you. Your feasibility is secured.
architectural.lede: One thing left to do: tell us about the project properly, so the analysis starts from everything you know.

steps.title: A receipt from Stripe
steps.body: In your inbox in the next few minutes, with your deposit amount and reference.

steps.title: Complete your project brief
steps.body: The button above opens it. Your calculator answers are carried forward, so nothing is asked twice. This is where you add plans, photos and anything else that defines the building.

steps.title: A call to validate the brief
steps.body: Once your brief is in, our team reviews it and books a short call to capture anything the form could not.

steps.title: Your feasibility in five working days
steps.body: Sketch scheme, proposed layout, unit and bedroom testing, and a one-hour call with the designer. The five days start once your brief and payment are complete.

automated.heading: Thank you. Your automated feasibility is underway.
automated.lede: One thing left to do: tell us about the project properly, so the analysis starts from everything you know.

steps.title: A receipt from Stripe
steps.body: In your inbox in the next few minutes, with the amount and reference. £49.99 paid in full, nothing further to pay.

steps.title: Complete your project brief
steps.body: The button above opens it. This is what your automated analysis is built from, so the more complete it is, the better the report.

steps.title: Your report, by email
steps.body: Fully automated, no design review at this tier: planning, standards, indicative capacity, risks and recommended next steps.

steps.title: A free Expert Session, if it makes sense
steps.body: Once you have the report, we will offer a short call with Jodi to talk through whether an Architectural Feasibility or another service is the right next step.

support.heading: Something to send us, or a question?
support.body: Reply to your receipt, or email us directly and we will pick it up.
support.linkLabel: See what a feasibility looks like
